title: Make Phrase the default rhythm
acceptance: A fresh Reader setup, the tempers and Today's poem default to phrase; Today reads in phrases on every date.
A saved Word default migrates to Phrase once; a reader who then picks Word keeps it.
The compiler default is unchanged and Composer sessions still compile in sentences.

evidence.note: Package A4. The owner reports phrase was widely preferred in user testing; no recording exists.

Phrase default, phrase tempers, one-time migration that keeps Word under Fit.
Local: 17 unit files (206 tests) and the Fit, Home and Today browser specs (32) pass; Today reads in phrases on every date of the cycle. Not yet observed with readers.

summary: Reader setup, every temper and therefore rolls, Home and Today's poem read in phrases; Word stays a choice. A pre-change saved Word becomes Phrase once unless the reader uses Fit; the compiler default and Composer's sentences are unchanged.
